subject: Implementation roadmap and phased responsibility register for Elmwood Health — MAP draft
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Thomas <emily.thomas@elmwoodhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Implementation roadmap and phased responsibility register for Elmwood Health — MAP draft

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As promised, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that breaks the onboarding into three phases with clear milestone dates and owners. High-level summary below — full spreadsheet is attached (Elmwood_MAP_v1.xlsx).

Phase 0 — Prep (Dec 6–Dec 17)
- Kickoff + tech intake (owner: Elmwood IT / David Park) — target Dec 8
- Account admin provisioning (owner: Elmwood Admin + Naomi) — Dec 10
- Security questionnaire follow-up (owner: Naomi / Ben) — Dec 13

Phase 1 — Integration & Core Mapping (Dec 20–Jan 14)
- API integration + sample dataset tests (owner: Soojin) — complete by Jan 7
- Embedding verification and privacy checks (owner: Ben) — complete by Jan 10
- Internal training for 5 power users (owner: Marissa) — Jan 14

Phase 2 — Pilot & Go-live (Jan 17–Feb 4)
- Pilot run with 3 internal teams (owner: Marissa) — Feb 1
- Final acceptance and cutover (owner: Naomi & Elmwood PM) — Feb 4

Open items I flagged in the spreadsheet: procurement terms, SOW redline, and a proposed weekly stand cadence until go-live. I also attached a draft SOW (SOW_Draft_Elmwood_v0.3.pdf) for your procurement team to review.

Could you confirm: (1) a preferred go-live week (we penciled Feb 1–7), (2) who will be the Elmwood PM we should include on the recurring cadence, and (3) whether procurement wants a separate review call this week?

Thanks — I’ll loop in Ben and Soojin for implementation details after your reply.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Attachments: Elmwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOW_Draft_Elmwood_v0.3.pdf
From: Emily Thomas <emily.thomas@elmwoodhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Park <david.park@elmwoodhealth.com>, procurement@elmwoodhealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Implementation roadmap and phased responsibility register for Elmwood Health — MAP draft

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Quick answers up front:
1) Go-live: Our leadership prefers the week of Feb 8 if that remains realistic (one-week push).
2) Elmwood PM: David Park will own execution on our side; I CC'd him here.
3) Procurement: Yes — they asked for a short call to run through the SOW and security terms. Procurement folks (procurement@elmwoodhealth.com) are available Thu or Fri afternoon this week.

A couple of asks after scanning the MAP:
- Can you add a single-line acceptance criteria for the pilot (what counts as success)?
- Please confirm data retention settings and whether logs can be exported on request for our audit team.

If you can update the MAP and SOW with those items, I can send them to procurement ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Emily
Director of AI Programs, Elmwood Health
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Thomas <emily.thomas@elmwoodhealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Implementation roadmap & MAP — acceptance criteria and retention notes

Emily, Naomi — thanks for the quick turnaround. Naomi forwarded the MAP and SOW; I made two edits and attached an implementation RACI (implementation_sprint_RACI.csv).

- Acceptance criteria for pilot (added):
  * Accuracy/quality: Pilot will demonstrate that median user satisfaction >= 85% on 100 sample interactions across 3 teams
  * Latency: 95th percentile inference latency under 350ms for standard queries
  * Stability: No more than 2 incident-level events in 2 weeks of pilot testing

- Data retention and audit logs: Redwood supports configurable retention windows. For Elmwood we recommend: 90-day retention of request/response logs by default with an option for archival export. Logs can be exported as CSV or ingested to Elmwood's SIEM via secure transfer (we've added export instructions to the SOW appendix). If you need a longer retention window we can add that to the SOW as an option (pricing dependent).

I also updated owners to reflect David as Elmwood PM and shifted the internal milestone owners: Soojin — integration lead; Marissa — adoption & training; Naomi — commercial & acceptance; Ben — technical security lead.

I'll be on the procurement call if needed — recommend Thu 2:00–2:30pm PT. Naomi, can you send a calendar invite?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Success Delivery, Redwood Inference
Attachments: implementation_sprint_RACI.csv
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: David Park <david.park@elmwoodhealth.com>, Emily Thomas <emily.thomas@elmwoodhealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Implementation roadmap & MAP — sprint breakdown and kickoff options

Hi David/Emily/Naomi — looping in a draft sprint-level plan (summary below). I can walk through this at the procurement call or at a separate kickoff.

Sprint 0 (Prep) — Dec 6–17- Network & firewall rules confirmed (Elmwood IT)- API keys issued (Elmwood Admin + Naomi)- Access to sandbox dataset (Elmwood IT)

Sprint 1 (Integration) — Dec 20–Jan 7- Schema mapping and ingestion (owner: Elmwood Data + Soojin)- End-to-end test with synthetic data (owner: Soojin)

Sprint 2 (Validation) — Jan 10–Jan 21- Embedding verification & privacy checks (Ben)- Fine-tune prompt templates & evaluation (Marissa)

Sprint 3 (Pilot) — Jan 24–Feb 4- Pilot execution (3 teams) + weekly checkpoints (Marissa + Elmwood PM)- Acceptance assessment (Naomi + Ben)

Kickoff options: Wed Dec 8 10:30–11:00 PT or Thu Dec 9 14:00–14:30 PT. I've created a provisional calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/elmwood-kickoff (please confirm preferred slot).

Notes: We will keep changes to production surface area limited during the pilot; all model/config rollouts will be feature-flagged and documented in the MAP.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Implementation Program Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Thomas <emily.thomas@elmwoodhealth.com>, David Park <david.park@elmwoodhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, procurement@elmwoodhealth.com

Subject: Re: Implementation roadmap & MAP — confirmation and next steps

Emily / David — thanks for confirming David as PM and for the procurement availability. Per the team's preferences we will shift go-live to the week of Feb 8 (one-week push).

Action items we will complete today:
- Naomi: update MAP with acceptance criteria + push new dates to Dec 8 kickoffs and Feb 8 go-live window. (attached: Elmwood_MAP_v1.xlsx updated)
- Ben: finalize SOW appendix on logs and retention; join procurement call Thu 2:00pm PT. (attached: SOW_Draft_Elmwood_v0.3.pdf)
- Soojin: upload sprint RACI and Miro board link for Elmwood review (miro_board_access.txt).
- David / Elmwood: confirm Thu 2:00–2:30pm PT for procurement review or propose alternate slot.

I'll send a calendar invite for Thu 2:00pm PT with the updated MAP and SOW attached. If procurement needs additional legal language ahead of the call, please flag specific clauses and we'll expedite redlines.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
